features.quote: Limit to a fixed number of turns, e.g.: - 8 turns minimum, - 12 turns typical, - 15 turns maximum.
Run ends when: - max turns reached, - agent declares completion, - agent gives up, - or agent enters a clearly nonproductive loop for several turns.
Your benchmark should not encourage eliciting extreme content unnecessarily.
